title: Jana Nayagan Wraps Up as Kollywood's Fourth Highest-Grossing Hindi Release of All Time
excerpt: Thalapathy Vijay's political thriller earned ₹17.83 crore in Hindi, delivering nearly double its investment and giving the Tamil superstar a triumphant final box office run.
body:
• Jan Neta (Hindi version of Jana Nayagan) closes with ₹17.83 crore net, becoming Kollywood's 4th highest-grossing Hindi release of all time
  • Against a ₹9 crore Hindi release budget, the film delivered nearly 100% returns, making it a clean box office success
  • Thalapathy Vijay's final film before entering politics finishes as his 2nd highest Hindi grosser after Leo
  • The worldwide collection crossed ₹200 crore, with strong overseas numbers from Malaysia, UK, and North America

A Profitable Farewell

Thalapathy Vijay's political thriller Jana Nayagan — released in Hindi as Jan Neta — has completed its theatrical run, closing at ₹17.83 crore net in the Hindi belt after 23 days, according to data from Bollywood Hungama. The film, directed by H. Vinoth, wraps up as the fourth highest-grossing Kollywood film ever in the Hindi market, behind 2.0, Kabali and Leo.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=fJaAYcERf3Y

"Three Weeks at the Box Office Jan Neta opened to ₹1.82 crore on July 23, registering Kollywood's eighth biggest Hindi opening day."

With an estimated ₹9 crore spent on the Hindi release, Jan Neta delivered nearly double its investment, making it South cinema's first success in the Hindi language in 2026. Both Ram Charan's Peddi and Prabhas's The Raja Saab, despite earning more in their opening weekends, ended as losing affairs in the Hindi belt.

Three Weeks at the Box Office

Jan Neta opened to ₹1.82 crore on July 23, registering Kollywood's eighth biggest Hindi opening day. The film picked up momentum over the first weekend, hitting its peak single-day collection of ₹3.20 crore on Sunday. The opening weekend total of ₹9.68 crore essentially covered the entire Hindi release budget in four days.

Week one ended at ₹14.09 crore. The second and third weeks added ₹2.71 crore and ₹1.03 crore respectively, as new releases and unfavorable word-of-mouth took their toll. Collections dropped to near-zero levels by mid-August, signaling the end of the theatrical run.

Vijay's Hindi Market Growth

For Thalapathy Vijay, the film finishes as his second highest-grossing Hindi release of all time, surpassing The Greatest Of All Time (₹15.25 crore) but falling short of Leo's ₹27.17 crore. The progression from Varisu (₹7.92 crore) to Jan Neta reflects Vijay's steadily expanding pan-India footprint.

A significant factor was Jan Neta's release across national cinema chains PVR Inox and Cinepolis, a departure from the limited Hindi releases of earlier Vijay films. Despite virtually no Hindi-market promotions, the film found its audience through Vijay's loyal fan base in the Hindi belt.

Worldwide Performance

The original Tamil version, Jana Nayagan, performed strongly in both the domestic market and overseas. The film crossed the ₹200 crore worldwide gross mark in its opening weekend, becoming Vijay's eighth highest-grossing film globally. In the overseas market, it became Kollywood's highest-grossing film of 2026, surpassing Karuppu's ₹81.15 crore, with strong collections from Malaysia, the UK, Europe, North America and the Middle East.

Vijay's Final Act

Jana Nayagan carries added significance as Thalapathy Vijay's final film before his transition to full-time politics with his Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam party. Despite mixed reviews criticizing the screenplay, fans rallied to give Vijay a fitting theatrical farewell. Whether the political thriller's themes will translate to real-world campaign success remains to be seen, but at the box office, Vijay's star power delivered one last time.
